title: Mommy's Lemonade (Margaritas)
description: Mommy's lemonade (margaritas) recipe relies on Minute Maid limeade, tequila, and orange liqueur to make a pitcher of this quick and popular cocktail.
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen limeade concentrate (such as Minute Maid®), thawed
1 (12 fluid ounce) can tequila (such as Cuervo® Especial)
0.5 (12 fluid ounce) can brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
1 pinch kosher salt for rimming glasses

steps.text: Pour limeade concentrate into a pitcher; fill the can with cold water three times, pouring each into the pitcher. Fill the can with tequila; pour into the pitcher. Fill the can halfway with orange liqueur; pour into the pitcher. Stir well; chill, about 30 minutes.
Pour salt onto a small, shallow plate. Moisten rims of 12 glasses with 1 lime wedge; dip moistened glasses into salt.
Fill glasses with ice; pour in margarita. Garnish with lime wedges.
